text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"MA","level":"state","category":"application_screening_fees","status":"in_force","title":"Massachusetts limit on upfront tenant charges (no application fees by lessors); licensed brokers may charge fees","requirement":"Before the start of a tenancy, a lessor may require payment only of first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit, and a lock-change fee. Application fees, pet fees, cleaning fees, amenity fees and all other upfront charges by landlords are forbidden. Licensed brokers may charge fees to prospective tenants if they comply with the board of registration regulations (254 CMR 7), including giving the applicant written notice at the first personal meeting of the fee amount, time and manner of payment, and whether it is contingent on a lease being signed.
